description: Cast a Qimen Dunjia (奇门遁甲) hour chart (Chaibu bureau method, rotating plate) for a date and time in Beijing time (Asia/Shanghai, UTC+8), the same reference QimenMind uses for question charts. Convert other local times to UTC+8 first; no location or true-solar-time correction is applied. Returns the four pillars, Yin/Yang Dun and Ju number, Zhi Fu / Zhi Shi, and the nine palaces with heaven/earth stems, star, door, deity, 81-pattern name, void and horse markers.
name: qimen_chart
title: Cast a Qimen Dunjia chart
